caption: The drawing depicts three views of a single round, decorative object set against a light beige background. At the top is a front elevation view, showing the object as a symmetrical circular grille with a radiating pattern of openings that form petal and clover-like shapes. Four evenly spaced tabs or legs extend slightly from the outer edge. Below this, a side profile view shows the object as flat with short, curved legs at the base, and a small scale or ruler for reference. At the bottom of the composition, a perspective view displays the object at an angle, showcasing its round surface and gridwork pattern with a central hole. The drawing employs black and gray tones for the object and light pencil lines for technical details, with the name "Helen Hobart" written in the bottom left corner. The background remains unadorned and uniform.
title: Trivet
